blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: Big O — Asymptotic growth of algorithm work.
O(log n) — Logarithmic growth, e.g. halving search intervals.
O(n²) — Quadratic growth, e.g. complete nested scans.

blocks.title: Start with n
blocks.text: n is the number of items. More items usually mean more operations.

blocks.title: Trace loop nesting
blocks.text: One full scan performs n steps. A nested n-by-n scan performs n² steps.

blocks.title: Compare growth
blocks.text: When n doubles, linear work doubles; quadratic work roughly quadruples. Big O describes growth, not seconds.
